population.span: We enrolled 7868 women between the ages of 60 and 90 years who had a bone mineral density T score of less than -2.5 but not less than -4.0 at the lumbar spine or total hip.

endpoint.span: The primary end point was new vertebral fracture.

estimate.span: As compared with placebo, denosumab reduced the risk of new radiographic vertebral fracture, with a cumulative incidence of 2.3% in the denosumab group, versus 7.2% in the placebo group (risk ratio, 0.32; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.26 to 0.41; P<0.001)

ci.span: As compared with placebo, denosumab reduced the risk of new radiographic vertebral fracture, with a cumulative incidence of 2.3% in the denosumab group, versus 7.2% in the placebo group (risk ratio, 0.32; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.26 to 0.41; P<0.001)

analysis_set.span: Primary Efficacy Analysis Set, which includes all randomized participants who have a baseline and \u2265 1 postbaseline evaluation of vertebral fracture at or before 3 years. Last Observation Carried Forward was used.

treatment_strategy.span: Subjects were randomly assigned to receive either 60 mg of denosumab or placebo subcutaneously every 6 months for 36 months.

follow_up.span: Denosumab given subcutaneously twice yearly for 36 months was associated with a reduction in the risk of vertebral, nonvertebral, and hip fractures in women with osteoporosis.

served_mismatch: The served RR 0.32 and 95% CI 0.26 to 0.41 match the source, but the intention-to-treat label misstates the endpoint's restricted Primary Efficacy Analysis Set, which requires baseline and postbaseline vertebral-fracture evaluations and uses Last Observation Carried Forward. Also, served_outcome.served_estimand is HR, whereas this endpoint's reported effect is RR.

candidate_rejections.span: Primary Efficacy Analysis Set, which includes all randomized participants who have a baseline and \u2265 1 postbaseline evaluation of vertebral fracture at or before 3 years. Last Observation Carried Forward was used.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject the served candidate's unrestricted intention-to-treat attribution; retain the reported estimate bound to the stated Primary Efficacy Analysis Set.
Reject the HR designation in served_outcome.served_estimand; the reported vertebral-fracture estimate is a risk ratio.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population is postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, matching the clinical question; the requested intention-to-treat analysis is a separate mismatch.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Denosumab for prevention of fractures in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis.

notes: Abstract spans bind the population, endpoint, estimate, confidence interval, treatment and follow-up. A registry span supplies the endpoint-specific analysis set; the registry also states DOUBLE masking.
